subject: POC Trial Planning — Model selection & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up: trial scope & next steps

Hi Carla —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Good recap below and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off next week.

Summary of needs you mentioned:
- Use-case: multilingual product Q&A and search assist for product pages (EN, ES, FR).
- Throughput: ~15 reqs/sec peak for the first 30-day trial.
- Latency goal: p50 < 150ms; p95 < 400ms.
- Success criteria: intent accuracy >= 88% on your labeled set; user satisfaction baseline +10 pts in NPS-measure during trial; false positive/hallucination threshold < 2% on curated testset.
- Data constraints: no PII retention; logs to be stored in customer-controlled S3 with encryption (you have an existing bucket).

Proposed POC plan (high-level):
1) Timeline: Week 0 (setup + model selection), Week 1–3 (evaluation & tuning), Week 4 (final review & decision).
2) Owners: Marissa (program lead, account), Aditya (solutions engineer — infra + model tuning), Dev (customer success — ingestion + retention/compliance).
3) Model selection: start with Meta Llama 2 13B (q4_8bit quantized) as primary for quality per-token; fallback to Mistral-7B-instruct quantized for low-latency heavy traffic routes. For Spanish/French, we recommend testing mT5 small for translation fallback if we see degradation vs the multilingual LLM; we can also try a multilingual variant (Llama 2 multilingual fine-tune) if the initial results are unsatisfactory.
4) Eval plan: we will run a held-out labeled set (you to provide ~2k queries across EN/ES/FR) and measure intent accuracy, top-1 relevancy, hallucination rate (manual review on a 5% sample), latency and cost-per-1M tokens.
5) Security & compliance: we'll use dedicated VPC peering and the S3 bucket for logs; no raw transcript retention in Redwood by default.

Attached is a short POC requirements doc and our POC template. Could you confirm: 1) the 2k test queries will be available by Monday EOD? 2) who on your side owns the S3 bucket setup and IAM?

If that looks good I will book a setup slot with Aditya for next Tuesday.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: cloudretail_poc_requirements.pdf, redwood_poc_template.xlsx

Carla

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla@cloudretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: trial scope & next steps

Hi Carla — great to meet you on the call. Quick answers to your asks and more detail on the model plan.

Ballpark cost estimate (30-day trial):
- Baseline: using Llama 2 13B quantized on one dedicated GPU with typical batching we expect ~ $1.2k–$2.5k for the evaluation duration depending on usage patterns.
- Fallback Mistral-7B routes will reduce token cost by ~35% for high-throughput serving.
- We will provide a usage report daily and a final cost breakdown; this is an estimate for procurement only.

Multilingual evaluation approach:
- Primary: run the test queries (EN/ES/FR) directly against the primary model and measure intent/intent accuracy per language.
- If performance in ES/FR is >5% worse than EN on key metrics, we will try two options in parallel: (a) mT5-small translate-then-run (translate incoming query to EN, run model, translate back) and (b) a multilingual fine-tuned variant of Llama 2 (we can deploy a small fine-tune if needed). We'll report per-language metrics so you can choose which tradeoff you prefer.

Model selection / routes for POC (proposed):
- Route A (default): Llama 2 13B (q4_8bit) — highest-quality path.
- Route B (fallback): Mistral-7B-instruct (q4_8bit) — used for bursty traffic / lower-cost routes.
- Route C (translation fallback): mT5-small (translation) + Llama 2 for answers — only if we observe language degradation.

Operational notes:
- We'll set up prefix caching for frequent queries to drop latency and cost.
- We'll instrument per-request token counts and per-route latency so we can tune batching/autoscaling.

Next steps I will take: schedule an infra sync with Samir to provision the read-only S3 keys and share the initial model config (model ids, quantization preset, route weights).

Cheers,
Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudretail.com>

Aditya / Marissa — looping in infra details. I created a staging bucket: s3://cloudretail-staging-poc. I can create a read-only IAM role for Redwood with prefix access to /poc/logs/.

I have two questions on retention and redaction:
1) We want to ensure PII (customer emails, credit card fragments) are redacted before being stored — can your ingestion pipeline apply redaction rules?
2) Retention: we'll keep logs in the bucket for 30 days and then auto-archive. Is that compatible with Redwood's evaluation tooling?

I'll wait for the read-only role request.

—Samir
Senior Infra Engineer | CloudRetail

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: trial scope & next steps

Samir — yes, we can do both. Redwood's ingestion supports pre-ingest redaction rules (regex + custom blocklists) and we can perform client-side redaction in your environment if needed. We will not persist raw transcripts in Redwood by default; we only write aggregated logs unless you explicitly opt-in. 30-day retention in the customer S3 bucket is fine — our tooling can read metrics and then stop pulling once logs are archived.

Action items recapped:
- Carla: provide 2k labeled queries by Mon EOD.
- Samir: create read-only IAM role for s3://cloudretail-staging-poc/poc/logs/ (we'll send the role ARN template).
- Marissa: finalize purchase approval path with Carla/procurement (Marissa to follow up on cost estimate).
- Aditya: schedule infra sync + push initial model config (Llama 2 13B primary / Mistral-7B fallback).

I'll send the role template and short redaction doc after this thread.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
